title: Finding commonalities and sharing results effectively are imperative for co-creative decolonial Arctic research
content:
by Susanna Gartler, Ria-Maria Adams, Sophie Elixhauser, Charleen Fisher, Ellen Marie Jensen, Simon Jungblut, Hugues Lantuit, Alexandra Meyer, Gertrude Saxinger

In recent years, Arctic Indigenous Peoples have articulated clear guidelines for equitable research practices. However, two interconnected aspects warrant greater attention: identifying commonalities and sharing research results. Research must be grounded in shared goals established through co-creative processes between Arctic communities and scientists. Based on these commonalities, scientific results must be shared effectively and continuously with communities, requiring knowledge-sharing to be embedded in funding schemes and project designs.
author: Susanna Gartler
